title: BiLSTM Toxicity Classifier with Residual Head
summary: The solution uses a word-level two-layer bidirectional LSTM with max and average pooling and a dense residual head. Configuration indicates lowercasing, sequence-length truncation, minimum token frequency and maximum vocabulary controls. Training uses soft targets, an auxiliary identity-target objective, and sample weights combining a base weight with identity, toxic-background and non-toxic-subgroup components. It uses fp16 autocast with gradient scaling, gradient clipping, learning-rate decay and a learning-rate floor. Stochastic weight averaging is configured from a selected epoch and interval. A residual head is trained with Adam using sampled positive and negative examples from cell-specific pools; residual sampling caps and positive/negative mixing are swept. Final validation predictions are selected from the best weight/source configuration, evaluated, and saved with the model checkpoint, metrics and configuration.
